message.content:
Irish whistle/tin whistle classification: HTSUS 9205.90 covers other wind musical instruments. 9205.90.20 is flageolets, recorders, and similar instruments (pitch pipes, etc.). Specifically, 9205.90.20 covers "Flutes, piccolos, fifes, ... "? Recall the structure: 9205.10 brass-wind instruments (military bugles etc.); 9205.90 other: 9205.90.10 Woodwind: Clarinets, flutes... Actually: 9205.90.10 "Pipe organs; keyboard instruments..."; 9205.90.20 "Accordions and similar instruments"; 9205.90.40 "Harmonicas"; 9205.90.60 "Other" ... I recall 9205.90.6000 as "Other" wind instruments, with parts in 9209. CBP rulings on tin whistles classify them in 9205.90.6000 (other). I'll go with that.

{"hts_code": "9205.90.6000", "reason": "A tin/Irish whistle is a fipple-flute wind musical instrument of heading 9205 that is not a brass-wind instrument, accordion, or harmonica, so it falls in the residual 'other' wind instruments subheading."}
